name: Gunawan Paggaru
bio: Ketua Umum Badan Perfilman Indonesia periode 2026-2030. Memimpin orkestrasi ekosistem perfilman nasional menuju daya saing global.
bioEn: Chairperson of the Indonesian Film Board 2026-2030, leading national cinema policy and global competitiveness.

name: Chandra Endroputro
bio: Memimpin tata kelola administrasi, legalitas organisasi, dan koordinasi strategis antardivisi BPI.
bioEn: Leading organizational administration, legal governance, and inter-departmental coordination.

name: Lulu Ratna
bio: Mengoordinasikan integrasi program komunitas perfilman, kurasi arsip, dan penguatan ekosistem sinema nusantara.
bioEn: Coordinating cinema community programs, archival preservation, and ecosystem integration.

name: Angga Dwimas Sasongko
bio: Mengawal kepatuhan regulasi, advokasi peraturan perundang-undangan perfilman, serta perlindungan hukum sineas.
bioEn: Guiding regulatory compliance, cinema legislative advocacy, and legal protection for filmmakers.

name: Vivian Idris
bio: Mengelola akuntabilitas keuangan organisasi, transparansi permodalan program, dan tata kelola pendanaan.
bioEn: Managing financial accountability, program capitalization transparency, and fiscal governance.

name: Celerina Judisari
bio: Mengelola pembinaan kelembagaan asosiasi profesi anggota BPI dan tata kelola internal organisasi.
bioEn: Overseeing guild institution development, internal governance, and membership protocols.

name: Garin Nugroho
bio: Melaksanakan kajian data industri, sensus penonton bioskop, dan analisis ekonomi perfilman nasional.
bioEn: Executing cinema industry data studies, audience census, and economic trend research.

name: Salman Aristo
bio: Mengembangkan standarisasi kompetensi profesi film, sertifikasi SKKNI, dan pelatihan vokasi sinema.
bioEn: Developing cinema competence standards, vocational SKKNI certification, and creative bootcamps.

name: Reza Rahadian
bio: Mengkoordinasikan penyelenggaraan festival film dalam negeri dan standarisasi kurasi festival nasional.
bioEn: Coordinating domestic film festival circuits and national curation standards.

name: Gina S. Noer
bio: Meningkatkan apresiasi masyarakat terhadap film nasional melalui program literasi sekolah dan ruang publik.
bioEn: Advancing public appreciation and media literacy for Indonesian cinema across schools and public spheres.

name: Kamila Andini
bio: Menjalin kemitraan pasar film global, fasilitasi ko-produksi lintas negara, dan delegasi festival internasional.
bioEn: Forging global market partnerships, cross-border co-productions, and international festival delegations.

name: Ifa Isfansyah
bio: Memperkuat komunitas film daerah, inkubasi sineas lokal, dan distribusi alternatif di luar ibukota.
bioEn: Strengthening provincial cinema communities, local auteur incubation, and regional distribution.

name: Chand Parwez Servia
bio: Menjembatani akses pendanaan perbankan, modal ventura, insentif pajak produksi, dan skema crowd-funding film.
bioEn: Facilitating banking capital, venture funding, production tax rebates, and co-financing models.

name: Mira Lesmana
bio: Mengawal restorasi seluloid sinema klasik Indonesia, digitalisasi arsip nasional, dan penyelamatan memori sinema.
bioEn: Overseeing classic cinema restoration, digital archiving, and national cinematic heritage conservation.

name: Joko Anwar
bio: Mendorong harmonisasi kebijakan pemerintah, insentif perfilman, dan perlindungan hak cipta karya anak bangsa.
bioEn: Championing progressive film legislation, copyright defense, and creative freedom safeguards.

name: Manoj Punjabi
bio: Membangun sinergi strategis dengan kementerian, asosiasi bisnis komersial, platform streaming, dan jaringan bioskop.
bioEn: Building strategic alliances with ministries, exhibitors, commercial networks, and streaming platforms.

name: Wregas Bhanuteja
bio: Mengelola narasi publik BPI, publikasi media, dan diseminasi program perfilman kepada masyarakat luas.
bioEn: Directing public narratives, official media relations, and nationwide outreach campaigns.

name: Shandy Gasella
bio: Menjalankan tata usaha operasional harian kantor BPI, dokumentasi persuratan, dan layanan kesekretariatan.
bioEn: Managing office administration, official records documentation, and day-to-day secretariat operations.

name: Lukman Sardi
bio: Memimpin pelaksanaan Piala Citra Festival Film Indonesia 2026, standarisasi dewan juri, dan akuntabilitas seleksi.
bioEn: Leading the 2026 Citra Awards, jury governance, and national award evaluation standards.

name: Riri Riza
role: Ketua Pokja Kajian dan Advokasi Rencana Induk Perfilman Indonesia
roleEn: Head of National Cinema Masterplan Working Group
department: Pokja Kajian dan Advokasi Rencana Induk Perfilman Indonesia
bio: Merumuskan dokumen cetak biru Rencana Induk Perfilman Indonesia jangka panjang menuju Indonesia Emas 2045.
bioEn: Formulating the long-term blueprint and masterplan for the Indonesian film industry toward 2045.

name: Sheila Timothy
bio: Gugus tugas gerak cepat dalam pemberantasan pembajakan digital, koordinasi take-down, dan perlindungan royalti sineas.
bioEn: Rapid response taskforce combating digital piracy, takedown coordination, and IP royalty enforcement.

name: Yandy Laurens
roleEn: Head of HR Acceleration Working Group
bio: Mempercepat transfer keterampilan kru muda, fasilitasi magang di set produksi besar, dan peningkatan kompetensi.
bioEn: Accelerating crew skill transfers, production on-set internships, and talent capacity building.

name: Edwin
roleEn: Head of Film Preservation Study Working Group
bio: Menyusun peta jalan inventarisasi arsip film nasional dan protokol standar preservasi laboratorium film.
bioEn: Drafting preservation roadmaps, archival inventory registries, and film laboratory storage protocols.

name: Marcella Zalianty
roleEn: Head of Film Law Revision Working Group
bio: Mengawal naskah akademik dan dengar pendapat bersama DPR RI untuk pembaruan Undang-Undang Perfilman No. 33 Tahun 2009.
bioEn: Spearheading academic drafting and parliamentary hearings for revising the National Film Law.

name: Triawan Munaf
bio: Tokoh ekonomi kreatif dan mantan Kepala Badan Ekonomi Kreatif RI, menjalankan fungsi pengawasan kinerja, akuntabilitas, dan tata kelola BPI.
bioEn: Creative economy pioneer supervising BPI governance and accountability.

name: Slamet Rahardjo
bio: Maestro seni peran dan sutradara teater/film, mengawal kesesuaian program kerja dengan mandat undang-undang dan marwah perfilman.
bioEn: Master actor and theater director overseeing program alignment with statutory film board mandate.

name: Mira Lesmana
bio: Produser film terkemuka dan pelopor kebangkitan sinema Indonesia modern, mengawasi tata kelola produksi dan proteksi hak cipta sineas.
bioEn: Leading producer supervising film production governance and copyright integrity.

name: Fauzan Zidni
bio: Produser dan praktisi asosiasi perfilman, mengawasi akuntabilitas kelembagaan serta koordinasi antar-asosiasi profesi.
bioEn: Producer and film association practitioner overseeing institutional accountability.

name: Cuk FK
bio: Sutradara dan pengurus komunitas perfilman, menjalankan fungsi pengawasan kepatuhan program terhadap ekosistem sinema.
bioEn: Director and cinema guild leader supervising program compliance.

name: Christine Hakim
bio: Aktris legendaris dan duta budaya Indonesia, memberikan pertimbangan nilai budaya, etika sinema, dan diplomasi perfilman internasional.
bioEn: Legendary actress and cultural diplomat providing guidance on cinematic ethics and heritage.

name: Deddy Mizwar
bio: Aktor, sutradara senior, dan mantan Ketua Badan Pertimbangan Perfilman Nasional (BP2N), memberikan nasehat kebijakan strategis perfilman.
bioEn: Senior actor, director, and former BP2N Chairman advising on national cinema policy.

name: Eros Djarot
bio: Budayawan, musisi, sutradara legendaris, dan tokoh perfilman Indonesia, memberikan arahan filosofi kebangsaan dalam karya sinema.
bioEn: Cultural thinker and master director guiding national cultural philosophy in cinema.

name: Reza Rahadian
bio: Aktor terkemuka dan Ketua Komite Festival Film Indonesia (2021-2023), memberikan masukan penguatan generasi penerus dan apresiasi publik.
bioEn: Acclaimed actor and former FFI Chairman advising on talent regeneration and public appreciation.

name: Marselli Sumarno
bio: Pengamat perfilman, akademisi sinema, dan kurator film nasional, memberikan telaah dan pertimbangan strategis kepakaran perfilman.
bioEn: Film scholar, cinema academic, and national film curator leading expert cinema advisory.

name: JB Kristanto
bio: Wartawan senior, kritikus film, dan penyusun Katalog Film Indonesia, memberikan kepakaran data historiografi perfilman nasional.
bioEn: Senior film critic and editor of the Indonesian Film Catalog providing historiographical expertise.

name: Seno Gumira Ajidarma
bio: Sastrawan, akademisi, dan Rektor IKJ (2016-2020), memberikan telaah teoritis narasi, estetika sinema, dan semiotika film nusantara.
bioEn: Author, film semiotician, and academic providing cinematic aesthetics and narrative expertise.

name: Prof. Dr. Sardono W. Kusumo
bio: Koreografer, sutradara film, dan Guru Besar Seni Pertunjukan, memberikan kepakaran dalam ekspresi seni visual dan performativitas.
bioEn: Choreographer and visual art professor advising on visual cinematic performance.

name: Nan T. Achnas
bio: Sutradara, produser, dan akademisi Fakultas Film dan Televisi IKJ, memberikan panduan kurikulum pendidikan dan riset sinematografi.
bioEn: Film director, producer, and academic guiding cinema education standards.

name: Tito Imanda
bio: Antropolog visual dan peneliti kebijakan perfilman, meneliti dinamika ekonomi politik dan ekosistem industri film Indonesia.
bioEn: Visual anthropologist and cinema policy researcher examining industrial economics.

name: Hikmat Darmawan
bio: Kritikus budaya populer, kurator, dan komisioner Dewan Kesenian Jakarta, memberikan kajian literasi sinema dan adaptasi lintas media.
bioEn: Pop-culture critic and curator advising on cinema literacy and cross-media adaptations.

name: Prilly Latuconsina
bio: Aktris dan produser muda, menggerakkan kampanye FFI Goes to Campus dan literasi apresiasi film bagi generasi muda.
bioEn: Actress and producer driving youth engagement and nationwide cinema appreciation.

name: Hanung Bramantyo
roleEn: Film Law Revision Working Group Member
bio: Sutradara senior, memberikan masukan praktis dari lapangan terkait regulasi izin syuting dan insentif daerah.
bioEn: Senior filmmaker providing on-set field insights on regional filming permits and incentives.

name: Mouly Surya
bio: Sutradara internasional, memfasilitasi kerja sama preservasi dan restorasi dengan laboratorium arsip sinema dunia.
bioEn: International auteur facilitating film restoration collaborations with world archive labs.
